title: Move the derivation rules into entities and derive a set's statistics
outcome: The scoring rules live in the domain layer as pure functions that both the server and the Redux store can call, and a set's statistics can be computed from its entries alone.
acceptanceCriteria: entities/game.ts exports deriveSetStats, deriveServingStatus, deriveSetPhase and getPreviousRally, ordered as types, then rules, then derivation.
Each moved function declares only the structure it reads, so a call passing EntryView[] type-checks with no cast and a call passing Entry[] type-checks with no cast.
deriveSetStats returns the same per-player and per-team totals that the existing rally helper produces when fed the same entries.
Used counts are derived and remaining allowances are the rule limit minus the used count, replacing TeamStatsClass initialising substitution to 6 while the helper increments it.
entities/ still imports nothing outside entities/.
